text: MARKETING AFFILIATE AGREEMENT
BIRCH FIRST GLOBAL INVESTMENTS INC.
MARKETING AFFILIATE AGREEMENT made as of the 8th day of May 2014 by and between Cybergy Holdings Inc. and Birch First Global Investments Inc.
8th day of May 2014
8th day of May 2014
The Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one year terms unless terminated in accordance with this Agreement.
Either party may terminate renewal by giving thirty days prior written notice.
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Nevada.
If more favorable commercial terms are granted to another similarly situated distributor the same terms shall be offered hereunder.
The restrictions shall not apply to passive investments of less than five percent of a public company.
During the Term the Affiliate shall not engage in a directly competing business within the Territory.
The rights granted to Affiliate are exclusive within the defined Territory during the Term.
Neither party shall solicit the customers of the other party for twelve months following termination.
Neither party shall knowingly solicit for employment the employees of the other party during the Term.
The parties agree not to make public statements intended to disparage the other party.
Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty days prior written notice.
Company shall have a right of first refusal with respect to any proposed sale of the specified assets.
A change of control of either party shall be deemed an assignment requiring consent.
Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party.
Affiliate shall receive twenty percent of net revenues generated from qualifying transactions.
Distributor shall not sell the licensed service below the minimum advertised price established by Company.
Distributor shall purchase a minimum annual quantity of one thousand units.
Sales under this Agreement shall not exceed the annual volume cap stated in Schedule A.
All right title and interest in work product created under this Agreement shall be assigned to Company.
Intellectual property developed jointly by the parties shall be jointly owned.
Licensor hereby grants Licensee a nonexclusive license to use and distribute the Licensed Materials in the Territory.
The license granted hereunder is personal to Licensee and may not be transferred.
Licensor may extend the licensed rights to its controlled affiliates.
Licensee may permit its wholly owned affiliates to exercise the licensed rights subject to this Agreement.
The subscription permits unlimited use of the licensed content during the subscription period.
The license is perpetual and irrevocable except in the event of material breach.
The source code shall be deposited with an independent escrow agent for release upon specified conditions.
Provider shall continue transition services for ninety days after termination.
Customer may audit Provider records upon reasonable notice to verify compliance with payment obligations.
The limitation of liability shall not apply to fraud willful misconduct or infringement claims.
Except for excluded claims each party's aggregate liability shall not exceed fees paid during the prior twelve months.
The breaching party shall pay liquidated damages of ten thousand dollars for each material violation.
The warranty period shall continue for twelve months after delivery.
Provider shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than two million dollars.
Licensee covenants not to sue Licensor for use of the licensed technology within the scope of this Agreement.
No person other than the parties shall be deemed a third party beneficiary of this Agreement.
